notes: Cycle dominated by the escalating Saudi-Houthi/Red Sea conflict. New in-window (16 Sep) negative developments used: US declines direct military backing after meeting Houthi leaders (Guardian); global oil-price surge as pipeline stays shut (NYT); US Level-3 'reconsider travel' advisory (Express Tribune); adversarial framing from Iranian state media Press TV (Yemeni strikes on Aramco/King Khalid Air Base, 'blockade'/'liberation' framing). Non-conflict themes (human rights, sportswashing, PIF, Vision 2030) returned only cumulative/older material, no fresh in-window items. Watchdog sweep: HRW's 15 Sep item concerned Houthi (not Saudi) war crimes and was already used in the 16 Sep edition; ALQST flagged a September Neom-displacement report not confirmable to the 24h window; Amnesty/Freedom House/CIVICUS/PEN cumulative only. Israeli outlets (Times of Israel, i24NEWS, Israel Hayom, Haaretz) surfaced in searches and were hard-excluded per source-eligibility policy.
continuity_note: Repo reports/ register was empty despite 60 delivered editions in the Dropbox test folder through 16 Sep; do-not-reuse working set reconstructed from the 7 most recent Dropbox editions (10-16 Sep, 99 unique article URLs) for this run's reuse check.
